description: Regulation of election expenditure Act, No.3 of 2023 - Under Section 3 (Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha Election)
reasoning: This gazette notification exclusively concerns electoral processes for the Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha (Local Authority) election. It details authorized campaign expenditure limits for candidates and political parties, reporting requirements for election expenses, and regulations regarding campaign donations. The content is published under the Regulation of Election Expenditure Act and involves the Election Commission's authority, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
